items.title: Higher For Longer Rates Put BlackRock And Cash ETFs In Focus
items.summary: With the Fed lifting the policy rate to 3.75%-4% and signaling higher-for-longer borrowing costs, cash is no longer just a parking bay; it is a battleground. Short-duration investment-grade bond and cash-equivalent ETFs now sit in the spotlight as investors weigh yield against stability and inflation risk.
